text: The purpose of this report is to provide a verbal update on an employee matter that is confidential as it is related to personal matters about an identifiable individual. The President and Chief Executive Officer proposes that the Committee meet in closed session to receive the update.

The TO Live - Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Receive the report (January 10, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
